title: MEDO Link device manifest
description: What a device uploads to POST /link/register. Each capability becomes (a) an LLM tool - its 'description' IS the tool description the model reads, so write it for the model - and (b) optional fast-path voice patterns. Capabilities with requires_confirmation route through MEDO's spoken yes/no safety gate (bilingual).

device_id.description: Stable lowercase identifier, e.g. 'robodog'. Also the poll URL segment.

name.description: Human name spoken by MEDO, e.g. 'the robot dog'.

description.description: One-line summary of the device (shown in the HUD).

transport.description: http_poll: device polls GET /link/commands/{device_id}. websocket: device holds /link/ws open and commands are pushed.

name.description: Capability id, e.g. 'walk_forward'. Tool name becomes '<device_id>_<name>'.

description.description: THE LLM TOOL DESCRIPTION. Tell the model when to call this and what it physically does.

params.description: JSON-schema style properties for the tool arguments, e.g. {"steps": {"type": "integer", "description": "how many steps"}}. Values are passed through to the device verbatim.

fast_patterns.description: Optional case-insensitive regexes for the no-LLM fast path, e.g. '\\b(robo)?dog,? sit\\b'.

requires_confirmation.description: true = MEDO asks a spoken yes/no before dispatching (use for anything that moves, heats, or spends).
